run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:15:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert is explained by the checkout service becoming unavailable after a chaos experiment mutated the checkout pod. The frontend's own error spans begin exactly with the fault window: zero through 01:14:06, first non-zero 5-minute error rate at 01:15:06 (0.248 error spans/s), peaking 3.085/s at 01:23:06 and still 0.952/s at the last reading 01:29:06. Those errors are confined to the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, tcp.connect) while cart, data and product routes are error-free. The checkout pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q has 11 restarts, is Ready=False with CrashLoopBackOff, and its last container termination was reason Error, exit code 2; its container and init container now run gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest although the Deployment template still specifies ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and busybox:latest, and the checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses. Chaos-mesh events show a Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay spawning a PodChaos every minute from 01:13:59 to 01:22:59, each reporting 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' and then a recovery ~55s later; checkout span emission stopped at 01:16:36 and has stayed zero. No other otel-demo pod restarted, product-catalog kept serving ~10-13 spans/s, and all flagd feature flags read as off. Conclusion is partial: the chaos custom resources cannot be read with the available tools, checkout container logs were unavailable, and Jaeger held no incident-window traces, so the exact fault parameters, the incident-time setting state and the exact error text remain unverified.

claims.text: For service frontend, spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR were zero at every reading from 00:54:06 through 01:14:06, then non-zero from 01:15:06 (0.248/s), peaked at 3.085/s at 01:23:06 and were still 0.952/s at the last returned reading 01:29:06.

The frontend error spans are confined to the checkout route: span_name POST /api/checkout and executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (both peaking 0.759/s at 01:23:06), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (same shape) and tcp.connect (peaking 0.056/s at 01:20:06-01:21:06); GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/cart and /api/data, GET, POST and the grpc AdService/GetAds, CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct client spans carry zero errors at every reading of the same query.
Span emission from service checkout stopped: its 2-minute span rate was non-zero until 01:16:06 (3.76/s) and returned 0 at every point from 01:16:36 through the last returned point 01:26:36.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (owner ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, startTime 2026-11-18T00:37:17Z) has restartCount 11 and ready=false; its container checkout is waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff and message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout', and its lastState is terminated with reason Error, exitCode 2, startedAt 2026-11-18T01:20:54Z, finishedAt 2026-11-18T01:20:59Z; the Pod Ready condition went False (ContainersNotReady) at 01:20:59Z.

Events for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q record reason Killing 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' 7 times from 01:13:59Z to 01:16:59Z, image pulls of 'gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest' 6 times from 01:13:59Z to 01:20:26Z, and reason BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout' 26 times from 01:15:59Z to 01:21:47Z.

At 01:34:15Z the pod spec of checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q had container 'checkout' running image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest and initContainer 'wait-for-kafka' also running gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest, while the checkout Deployment template specifies container checkout image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and initContainer wait-for-kafka image busybox:latest, and of the 21 otel-demo pods only checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q runs pause images (the others run their application images).

In namespace chaos-mesh, PodChaos objects named otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-zv9mn, -927gn, -d2m7w, -dc4vz, -jgn2n, -ktl9k, -vxxwz, -6cwbh, -qgddz and -gl228 each emitted 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' between 01:13:59Z and 01:22:59Z, each of the first nine followed about 55 seconds later by 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q'; the last one (gl228) applied at 01:22:59Z has no recovery event in the returned data.

In namespace chaos-mesh the Schedule named otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay emitted 'Create new object: otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-<suffix>' once per minute from 01:13:59Z through 01:22:59Z (10 Spawned events).
The checkout Service endpoint has no ready addresses: its only subset contains notReadyAddresses for ip 100.96.4.26 with targetRef Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q in namespace otel-demo.
Deployment checkout in namespace otel-demo has spec.replicas 1 but status.readyReplicas and status.availableReplicas are null, while every other otel-demo Deployment reports available 1 and ready 1.

Service frontend-proxy recorded its own error spans on operation 'ingress' (0.0113/s at 01:14:06, peaking 0.7778/s at 01:23:06, 0.2456/s at 01:29:06) and on operation 'router frontend egress' (0/s at 01:14:06, peaking 0.7667/s at 01:23:06, 0.2456/s at 01:29:06).

In the per-service, per-status query over 00:15:06-01:33:06, payment and accounting returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR series that were 0 at every reading; ad, fraud-detection and recommendation returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR rates of about 0.0037-0.0042/s that were already present from 01:06:06, before the incident; no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for product-catalog, cart, currency, email, image-provider, quote or shipping (a missing series is unknown, not zero).

Every otel-demo pod except checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (21 pods listed, all phase Running) has restartCount 0 and ready=true; the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg has restartCount 0 and ready=true.

Product-catalog kept emitting spans throughout the window (10.0-13.3/s, 4.87/s at the last reading 01:28:06) and frontend's total span rate stayed 25-55/s, so neither service stopped serving during the checkout outage.

The flagd-config ConfigMap (key demo.flagd.json) read at 01:34:09Z defines adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, and every one of them has defaultVariant 'off'.

A trace search for service frontend returned 5 traces (51 spans) whose span start times run only from 2026-11-18T01:08:01.9Z to 01:08:02.3Z, so no span-level detail for the 01:13-01:23 incident window was available from Jaeger.

The elevated frontend error rate is a consequence of the checkout pod being made unserviceable: its containers were replaced with pause images (so the checkout application could not run), the checkout Service therefore had only notReadyAddresses, and the frontend's checkout-path calls (grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect) failed from 01:15 onward, which is the error rate the RequestErrorRate alert reports on service frontend.

An additional, unverified candidate is that the checkout application itself failed to start (its last termination was reason Error with exit code 2 at 01:20:59Z) independently of the image swap; the checkout container's current and previous logs could not be read, so this cannot be separated from the injected fault.

The experiment and schedule names refer to product-catalog and network delay, but the chaos events state the chaos was applied to otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, and product-catalog kept emitting 10.0-13.3 spans/s with its pod ready and restartCount 0; no evidence was found that product-catalog itself was affected.

Frontend itself was not restarted and stayed ready (restartCount 0, ready=true) and its non-checkout routes recorded no error spans, so the frontend's own process health does not explain the error rate; the failures are on its checkout calls.

Feature-flag fault injection through flagd was considered and rejected as the cause: all twelve flags in flagd-config are at defaultVariant off, no flag targets checkout, and payment's STATUS_CODE_ERROR series is 0 for the whole window.

A checkout rollout or pod-template change was considered and rejected: the pod still bears its original name and owner ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb started 00:37:17Z, the Deployment template image is unchanged at ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, and the all-namespace event grouping shows new ReplicaSet/Deployment scale events only in namespace data-recorders.

A node-level failure was considered and rejected: checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q ran on node i-01375feffdca65277 together with cart, currency, email, frontend-proxy, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, postgresql and valkey pods, and all of those were ready with restartCount 0 during the same period.

Have the platform/chaos owner inspect and stop the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay (and its spawned PodChaos objects), then confirm the checkout pod is recreated from the unmodified Deployment template so that the pause images are gone, the checkout Service regains a ready endpoint and frontend's checkout-path error rate returns to zero.

After the checkout pod is restored, collect its container logs (including the instance that terminated with exit code 2) to confirm whether any application-level startup failure persists beyond the injected pause images.

gaps: The chaos custom resources themselves (Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and the PodChaos objects otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-*) could not be read: those kinds are not available to this Run, so the action, mode, target selector, duration and whether the schedule is still active could not be verified; only their events, the mutated pod spec and the pause images are evidence.
The change_history integration is not integrated, so when and by whom the chaos Schedule was created or modified is unknown.

Checkout container logs were not readable: fetch_pod_logs for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q over 01:10:00-01:33:00Z returned 0 lines and reported no previous instance for containers wait-for-kafka and checkout, so the exit code 2 termination and any application error text are unknown; fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg likewise returned 0 lines.

Jaeger retained no traces starting after about 2026-11-18T01:08:02Z, so the exact frontend error message (for example the gRPC status or connection error on CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) for the incident window could not be read from spans.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not found: list_prometheus_rules filtered by rule_name RequestErrorRate returned nothing, so the rule expression and the source of the annotation's value 3.5 are unknown; the trace-based frontend error-span rate peaked at 3.085/s at 01:23:06.

kube-state-metrics series are not present in this Prometheus (get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned nothing), so pod/deployment state over time could not be charted; pod and deployment state cited here are point-in-time observations at 01:33-01:35Z.
The networkpolicies query for namespace otel-demo returned no objects and is not citable evidence, so the presence or absence of NetworkPolicies affecting checkout traffic is unknown.
Metric data ends at 01:29:06Z and pod state was read at 01:33-01:35Z, so whether the checkout pod recovered or the alert cleared after 01:35Z is unknown.

The checkout Service having no ready endpoints and the pod's crash state are established, but which specific signal the alert rule uses (span status, HTTP 5xx or client RPC status) could not be confirmed because the rule was not found.
